Posted January 19, 2001
Special to MarijuanaNews
See
Police Raid Vancouver’s Blunt Bros. Steal Inventory and Seeds Next Door. They Reopened Immediately. Special to MarijuanaNews.com

This morning Marc Emery and I visited Blunt Bros. to check out the situation and tape a segment for Pot-TV.

First, it should be emphasized again that there were no " drugs " – including marijuana – found on the premises.

The search warrant said they were after " paraphernalia " -- which is technically illegal under Canadian law, but which is found everywhere in Vancouver, including the store next door.

Further East on Hastings Street there are places that sell more crack pipes than anything else. Consequently, it will certainly be easy for the Blunt Bros.’ lawyers to argue that this was selective prosecution.

The behavior of the Vancouver narks was predictably stupid. They took thousands of dollars worth of inventory without leaving a receipt, which is a violation of the police regulations -- for obvious reasons. They also broke down a door that the employees could have opened for them, finding nothing illegal. When the police finally departed, they left the front door open, even though they had ordered all of the employees to leave.

In any case, Blunt Bros., which is really a beautiful place that Vancouver should be proud to have, especially near such a blighted area, reopened and plans on continuing in business.

By the way, neither Vancouver newspaper reported this absurd waste of police resources. Why the narks chose this particular time to raid the place is still a mystery worth looking into. Stay tuned.
